items.description: Fuel breaks are linear strips of land along which vegetation is cleared or thinned—constructed along ridgelines, roads and other strategic places—to give firefighters a better chance to safely slow or steer a fire. They have been used since the 1960s across many landscapes.

Each additional hour of daytime sleep was associated with a 13% increase in mortality risk.
